messages:
morgan: Bringing up abyss-9b (int4) on canary. Seeing sporadic OOMs during warmstart and a lot of mem fragmentation. P50 latency ~85ms, P90 ~220ms but OOMs at ~30% of warm-started requests.

kai: Can you paste the OOM trace and current runtime config?

morgan: logs + config:
```
OOM: cudaMalloc failed at kv_cache_alloc.py:120
model: abyss-9b-int4
batching: microbatch:8, max_tokens_per_request:1024
kv_slot_reserve: 0.2
prefetch: enabled
```

esther: Interesting — kv_slot_reserve 0.2 is high for int4 model. Try dropping to 0.05 and reduce microbatch to 4. Also try lowering default max_gen_tokens -> 256 to avoid huge KV growth in warmstart.

samir: ran quick A/B on canary (10%):
- orig: OOM rate 28%, P90 220ms
- kv_slot_reserve=0.05 + microbatch=4 + max_gen_tokens=256 -> OOM 3%, P90 240ms
tradeoff: latency +20ms but stable

morgan: Nice. Can we try prefetched prefix eviction tweak too? Maybe trim older KV shards after 512 tokens.

esther: yeah set `kv_prune_threshold=512` and `prefetch_keep_ratio=0.8`. Also recommend quant-check to ensure accuracy doesn't drop: run eval harness on 1k prompts.

morgan: running eval now. deploy plan:
1) update model-config for abyss-9b: kv_slot_reserve=0.05, microbatch=4, max_gen_tokens=256, kv_prune_threshold=512
2) rollout canary 10% for 2 hours
3) run eval job and perf monitors
4) if OK, step to 50% then 100%

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout plan abyss-9b-config-2026-03-21 -> canary 10% (morgan)

samir: quick numbers from eval (first 500 prompts): quality delta -0.4% BLEU, -0.2% Rouge (within noise). Good to proceed.

kai: log note: if OOMs reappear, we should also try `prefix_caching=false` on storm pods to test fragmentation impact.

esther: +1. Also add metric alert for KV-alloc failures (count>1 per minute) and increase canary revert automation threshold.

morgan: thanks everyone. I'll push the canary config and monitor. Link to perf dashboard: https://internal.redwood/perf/abyss-9b/canary

samir: :thumbsup:

morgan: will post final rollback/acceptance after 4h.
